mapper.sql: CASE WHEN c.start_time > NOW() THEN 'UPCOMING' WHEN c.end_time < NOW() THEN 'ENDED' ELSE 'RUNNING' END

c.id, c.title, c.description, c.start_time, c.end_time, AS status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contest_problem cp WHERE cp.contest_id = c.id) AS problem_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contest_registration cr WHERE cr.contest_id = c.id) AS participant_count
mapper.select:
SELECT ,
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contest_registration cr WHERE cr.contest_id = c.id AND cr.user_id = #{userId}) AS registered
FALSE AS registered
FROM contest c WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT ,
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contest_registration cr WHERE cr.contest_id = c.id AND cr.user_id = #{userId}) AS registered
FALSE AS registered
FROM contest c
c.deleted = 0
AND = #{status}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.start_time > NOW() THEN 1 WHEN c.end_time < NOW() THEN 2 ELSE 0 END, c.start_time ASC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT cp.label, cp.question_id, q.title, q.difficulty, kp.name AS knowledge_point_name, cp.score, cp.sort_no FROM contest_problem cp JOIN question q ON q.id = cp.question_id AND q.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON kp.id = q.knowledge_point_id WHERE cp.contest_id = #{contestId} ORDER BY cp.sort_no ASC, cp.id ASC
SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.nickname FROM contest_registration cr JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = cr.user_id WHERE cr.contest_id = #{contestId} ORDER BY cr.create_time ASC, u.id ASC
SELECT user_id, question_id, status, create_time FROM submit_record WHERE contest_id = #{contestId} ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contest_registration WHERE contest_id = #{contestId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contest_registration WHERE contest_id = #{contestId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO contest_registration (contest_id, user_id, create_time) VALUES (#{contestId}, #{userId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO contest (title, description, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
INSERT INTO contest_problem (contest_id, question_id, label, sort_no, score, create_time) VALUES (#{contestId}, #{questionId}, #{label}, #{sortNo}, #{score}, NOW())
